codes.doc: External transfer or transfer of account

codes.name: ImpliedSpreadLegExecutedAgainstAnOutright
codes.doc: Implied spread leg executed against an outright

codes.name: AI
codes.doc: AI (Automated input facility disabled in response to an exchange request.)

codes.name: B
codes.doc: B (Transaction between two member firms where neither member firm is registered as a market maker in the security in question and neither is a designated fund manager. Also used by broker dealers when dealing with another broker which is not a member firm. Non-order book securities only.)

codes.name: LC
codes.doc: LC (Correction submitted more than three days after publication of the original trade report.)

codes.name: M
codes.doc: M (Transaction, other than a transaction resulting from a stock swap or stock switch, between two market makers registered in that security including IDB or a public display system trades. Non-order book securities only.)

codes.name: N
codes.doc: N (Non-protected portfolio transaction or a fully disclosed portfolio transaction)

codes.name: NM
codes.doc: NM ( i) transaction where Exchange has granted permission for non-publication

codes.name: NR
codes.doc: NR (Non-risk transaction in a SEATS security other than an AIM security)

codes.name: P
codes.doc: P (Protected portfolio transaction or a worked principal agreement to effect a portfolio transaction which includes order book securities)

codes.name: PC
codes.doc: PC (Contra trade for transaction which took place on a previous day and which was automatically executed on the Exchange trading system)

codes.name: PN
codes.doc: PN (Worked principal notification for a portfolio transaction which includes order book securities)

codes.name: R
codes.doc: R ( (i) riskless principal transaction between non-members where the buying and selling transactions are executed at different prices or on different terms (requires a trade report with trade type indicator R for each transaction)

codes.name: RO
codes.doc: RO (Transaction which resulted from the exercise of a traditional option or a stock-settled covered warrant)

codes.name: RT
codes.doc: RT (Risk transaction in a SEATS security, (excluding AIM security) reported by a market maker registered in that security)

codes.name: SW
codes.doc: SW (Transactions resulting from stock swap or a stock switch (one report is required for each line of stock))

codes.name: T
codes.doc: T (If reporting a single protected transaction)

codes.name: WN
codes.doc: WN (Worked principal notification for a single order book security)

codes.name: WT
codes.doc: WT (Worked principal transaction (other than a portfolio transaction))

codes.name: TrdSubmitVenueClrSettl
codes.doc: Trade submitted to venue for clearing and settlement
